- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: Step 0 (new bullet) and Cleanup section header (line 187) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The issue-mode cleanup trigger is positioned as a child of Step 0 (Session preflight), but the instructions specify it should run "once step 1 has read the plan" to obtain the `Source issue:` identifier. The cleanup-section header (line 187) continues to state that every stage session runs cleanup in Step 0.
  WHY: An unattended session walking through Step 0 will attempt the cleanup before Step 1 has read the plan. Because the `Source issue:` identifier is not yet available, the label check cannot resolve, the cleanup is skipped or fails silently, and the stopped session remains unarchived, defeating the purpose of the fix.

- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: Line 103 (rename) and Line 161 (label-read predicate) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: Transient failure paths for `set_session_title` (rename) or `mcp__github__issue_read` (label check) are not robustly defined.
  WHY: A transient rename failure may leave the session with its old title (which the cleanup will not match), and a label-read failure can silently skip archival without surfacing an error, requiring manual intervention to clean up the visible session list.

- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The fix's contract is that the issue-mode cleanup actually fires on a `/reclarify` resume, after Step 1 reads the plan and the `Source issue:` identifier is available.

The cleanup-section header at line 187 remains unchanged ("Every stage session runs this in step 0, after resume hygiene") with no issue-mode timing exception.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: line 12 (Step 0 child bullet "Issue-mode resume without a `— resume.` block") vs. line 15 (Step 1 "Resolve the plan doc.") vs. line 187 (Zombie-checker cleanup section header "Every stage session runs this in step 0, after resume hygiene") | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The new Step 0 bullet defers the issue-mode cleanup until "once step 1 has read the plan", but Step 1 has no operational instruction to invoke the cleanup and the cleanup-section header still directs every stage session to run it in Step 0.
  WHY: An unattended `/reclarify` resume walks Step 0's bullets, hits the new issue-mode bullet, and either (a) attempts cleanup in Step 0 without the `Source issue:` identifier (the label predicate "no longer carries `ai:claude-blocked`" cannot resolve because the plan hasn't been read yet, and the predicate silently falls through), or (b) defers per the bullet's text but never returns to run the cleanup because Step 1 ends with "Read it in full" with no hook to trigger it. In both cases the stopped `… — blocked on issue` session stays in the session list until a human archives it by hand — the exact failure mode this PR is meant to fix (cause 2 in the description: "The Zombie-checker cleanup ran only from inside resume hygiene, so it never ran on this path").

- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: line 187 (cleanup-section header "Every stage session runs this in step 0, after resume hygiene, so stray checkers never pile up:") | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup-section header is unchanged and contradicts the new Step 0 bullet's deferral. It still asserts cleanup runs in Step 0 with no issue-mode timing exception, while the new bullet describes a deferred-to-Step-1 path.
  WHY: An unattended session reading the header first attempts cleanup in Step 0 regardless of the deferred bullet's text, hits the missing-`Source-issue` failure path, and stops. The header never says "issue mode is the exception; for issue mode run the cleanup after Step 1 reads the plan". Future edits restoring the original header wording will not be flagged because the contract test only checks string presence, not the header sentence.

- tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py: lines 245-260 (test_issue_mode_archives_stopped_stage_sessions) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The contract test only checks that certain text strings exist in the file. It does not pin that Step 1's plan-read step references the cleanup, does not pin that the cleanup-section header distinguishes issue-mode timing, and does not pin the deferred trigger's placement relative to Step 1.
  WHY: A future edit that reorders bullets, drops the deferral text ("once step 1 has read the plan"), or revises the cleanup-section header back to "Every stage session runs this in step 0" without an issue-mode timing exception will still satisfy this test. The bug is reintroduced silently — the very regression PR description cause 2 ("cleanup only ran from resume hygiene, so it never ran on this path") is reintroduced with no CI signal.

- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: line 12 (Step 0 bullet tail "a plan without that line skips this"); line 191 (cleanup-section report line "plus `stopped stage sessions archived: <m>` in issue mode") | severity=NI
